decided: The README and the supported-tools page now say that fourteen workflows, every one but onboard, install a folder of reference files beside their skill, where they said eight.
alternatives: leave the figure at eight until a docs program rewrites the pages
list the fourteen workflows by name instead of giving a count
why: Every workflow but onboard has shipped the shared decision-records reference since decision records were added (onboard carries no decision-writing statement, so it ships none), so eight was already wrong before this stage; a count with the one exception named stays true as this stage adds more reference files.

relies_on.title: Decision-record reference ships beside the statement
